description: Experience the combination of luxury, performance, technology, and versatility in the 2018 Audi Q7 3.0T Premium Plus quattro. Power comes from a 3.0-liter TFSI turbocharged V6 engine paired with an 8-speed Tiptronic automatic transmission. The Q7's legendary quattro all-wheel-drive system helps provide confident traction and composed handling across a variety of road conditions. With responsive acceleration and refined road manners, the Q7 is equally comfortable navigating city streets, highways, and longer road trips.  The Premium Plus trim adds a desirable level of luxury and technology to the Q7 lineup. Inside, the cabin features upscale materials, comfortable seating, thoughtful design, and a refined atmosphere suited for both daily commuting and long-distance travel. The three-row configuration provides additional passenger flexibility, while the rear seats can be folded to create additional cargo capacity when needed.  Technology is an important part of the Q7 experience. Depending on equipment, features can include Audi MMI® infotainment, navigation, smartphone connectivity, a premium Bang & Olufsen® sound system, Audi virtual cockpit, Bluetooth®, and other advanced convenience features. These technologies help keep entertainment, navigation, communication, and vehicle information easily accessible.  The exterior reflects Audi's sophisticated design philosophy. The Q7 features a distinctive Singleframe® grille, sculpted body lines, premium lighting, and a sleek SUV profile. Its combination of athletic proportions and elegant styling gives the Q7 a premium presence without sacrificing practicality.  Comfort remains a major strength of the Q7.
